# Safe code review: `41ac7ce4…HEAD` (one commit, e27616f, "feat: enforce the plan's Safe seat limit with a typed 402")

Full run: 9 areas checked, findings argued for and against, scored. Nothing was edited, installed, run or posted.

33 files, +1,161 −186 · base e36e81e (merge-base) → HEAD e27616f · 10 stated rules (AGENTS.md) plus docs/agents · 9 of 9 areas have surface

| **Verdict** | **Request changes**: score **65 of 100**, capped by 2 confirmed High findings (it would be 91 without the cap) |
| **Held back by** | Seat-limit rejections go from 400 to 402 on deploy (REG-001) · extra queries on every add-Safe request (PRF-001) |
| **Fix first** | REG-001, then SEC-001 + PRF-001 + PRF-003 together (a single change covers all three, see below) |
| **Adjudicated** | 11 of 12 · 8 confirmed · 1 contested · 1 below the confidence floor · 1 refuted · 1 promoted from a deferral |

## Scores by area (worst first)
| Area | Score | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Performance | 77 | PRF-001 High, PRF-003 Low |
| Regression | 80 | REG-001 High |
| Testing | 89 | TST-001 Medium, TST-002 Low |

## What this review did not cover
- No tests, build or type-check were run (read-only request). Every finding comes from reading the code, not from running it.
- **Since your last run** is skipped. The stored `last-run.tsv` is from an unrelated diff on another worktree (base 8be0434, safe v2 files), so a comparison would mean nothing. I also left that file as it was: this run was read-only, and the record is shared across worktrees.
- DRY-001 was not adjudicated. It is a Nit, so it doesn't move the score.

## Fix before merging (P2)

**REG-001 · The seat-limit rejection changes from 400 to 402 as soon as this deploys** · High · confirmed
`src/modules/entitlements/routes/entitlements.service.ts:207-234` · `src/modules/spaces/routes/safes/space-safes.controller.ts:88-96`
- The enforcement date defaults to 2099 (`src/config/entities/configuration.ts:369-370`). That date only picks which quota number applies; `admit()` always throws `QuotaExceededError`.
- So the old `400 "This Workspace only allows a maximum of N Safe Accounts…"` becomes a `402 {code:"QUOTA_EXCEEDED",…}` on deploy. The comment's claim "deploying this enforces nothing" is misleading.
- **Fix:** either keep the 400 and its old body until the enforcement date, or make sure web and mobile handle the 402 before this ships, and correct the comment.

**PRF-001 · Every add-Safe request now does duplicate work** · High · confirmed (scope narrowed)
`src/modules/entitlements/routes/guards/entitlement.guard.ts:36` + `src/modules/spaces/routes/pipes/space-id.pipe.ts:35` (`findIdByUuid` ×2) · `src/modules/entitlements/routes/entitlements.service.ts:160` + `src/modules/spaces/domain/safes/space-safes.repository.ts:89` (`countBySpaceId` ×2)
- Before: 2 DB round-trips per request. Now: 5, whatever the enforcement date. After the date, add 2 Redis `hGet`s.
- The refuter showed the duplicate Redis reads don't happen today, which is why the scope is narrowed.

**BUG-001 · A stale plan can be cached right after an upgrade or downgrade** · Medium · confirmed
`src/modules/entitlements/routes/entitlements.service.ts:262-278` against `:567-573`
- A request that misses the cache reads the plan without a lock. If it reads before the upgrade commits and writes after the post-commit `deleteByKey`, the old grants go back into the cache.
- The cached value has no version (`src/modules/entitlements/domain/entities/feature-grant.entity.ts:13`), so nothing detects it. A space that just upgraded keeps getting 402 for up to the TTL (300 s). A downgraded space can go over its new limit for the same window.
- This only goes live once `ENTITLEMENTS_ENFORCEMENT_STARTS_AT` is set to a real date.
- **Fix:** stamp the cached value with the subscription's event time and ignore or skip older writes, or make the write conditional.

**TST-001 · The new 402 path has no test that goes through the real HTTP stack** · Medium · confirmed
`src/modules/spaces/routes/safes/space-safes.controller.ts:94-96`
- `space-safes.controller.e2e-spec.ts` already covers 401/403/404/422/400 for this route, but not 402. The new tests only check decorator metadata or use mocks.
- **Add:** a space at its limit gets 402 with the documented body · a space under the limit gets 201 · a non-member hitting an at-limit space (this pins SEC-001).
- Caveat: e2e isn't run in CI (`docs/agents/testing.md`).

## Worth a ticket (P3)
| ID | Where | What |
|---|---|---|
| SEC-001 | `src/modules/entitlements/routes/guards/entitlement.guard.ts:36-41` | `SafeSeatsGuard` runs before `assertAdmin` (`space-safes.service.ts:40`), so a non-member gets another space's `quota/used/resetsAt` in the 402 body. `getEntitlements` puts the same data behind `assertMember` (`entitlements.service.ts:340-345`). Medium. |
| PRF-003 | `src/modules/spaces/domain/safes/space-safes.repository.ts:71-89` | Every address is KMS-encrypted before the seat check. A batch that pushes the space over its limit pays N `GenerateDataKey` calls before being rejected; the old code rejected first. There's no `.max()` on the batch (`space-safe.dto.entity.ts:14`). Promoted from a deferral no pass had filed. |
| ARC-002 | `src/modules/entitlements/routes/entitlements.service.ts:1-60` | This `routes/` service went from 22 to 29 first-party imports. It now owns grant caching and is the cross-module `IEntitlementEnforcement` implementation. Move the cache and grants into a `domain/` collaborator (`docs/agents/ARCHITECTURE.md:101-102`). |
| TST-002 | `src/modules/entitlements/routes/entitlements.service.ts:221-227` | No test covers the fallback when a feature has no catalog row (it logs a warning and keeps the static limit). |

**One change covers SEC-001, PRF-001 and PRF-003.** Drop the early guard and do the early check in `SpaceSafesService.create`, after `assertAdmin` and before encrypting: count once with the real `delta`, then keep the locked recount as the authoritative check. That closes the non-member leak, removes a duplicate `findIdByUuid` and count, and rejects an overshooting batch before any KMS call. It also makes KIS-001 moot. Fixing SEC-001 inside the guard instead (by adding `assertMember`) would add a query and make PRF-001 worse.

## Your call
Fix now, ticket, or skip for each item above. Nothing has been applied or filed.

## Worth tidying (1 proposal, about 15 lines)
- DRY-001 (Nit), `src/modules/spaces/domain/safes/space-safes.repository.ts:22,49-57`: this is now the second copy of the space-scoped advisory-lock pattern. The other is `src/modules/entitlements/domain/subscriptions.repository.ts:16-17,96-106`, and namespaces 132, 1643 and 1827 are kept apart only by comments. A small shared helper with a namespace map would make a collision a compile error.

## Not sure about these · Ruled out
- **Contested, KIS-001** `src/modules/entitlements/routes/guards/entitlement.guard.ts:18`: an abstract guard with one subclass. The validator confirmed it; the refuter pointed to planned features already named in `src/modules/entitlements/domain/entitlements.constants.ts:65-70` (members, security hub, address book, copilot).
- **Below the floor, PRF-002** `src/modules/spaces/domain/safes/space-safes.repository.ts:86-120`: the seat lock is held across the audit log's KMS call, and the KMS client has no timeout. This only happens when `FF_SPACE_AUDIT_LOG` and `ENCRYPTION_ENABLED` are both on (both default to off).
- **Refuted, ARC-001** `src/modules/spaces/spaces.module.ts:60`: the new `SpacesModule ⇄ EntitlementsModule` `forwardRef` cycle is explicitly allowed by `docs/agents/nestjs-patterns.md:127,133`.
- **Checked and fine:** the lock and count now share one transaction, which fixes a race the old unlocked count had. SPDX headers, config/schema/.env pairing, `CacheRouter` keys, TTLs from config, the only `ISpaceSafesRepository.create` caller, the `Math.max(delta,1)` boundaries, and cached dates surviving a JSON round-trip.

## How this was produced
- Nine category passes in parallel. Each finding was then argued by an independent validator and refuter (22 agents), and outcomes combined with the plugin's table.
- Score = weighted average by area (91), capped at 65 because there are confirmed Highs. The number is `review-context/references/scoring.md` math, not judgement.
- Raw counts per area: security 1 · bugs 1 · regression 1 · testing 2 · architecture 2 · performance 2 (+1 promoted) · DRY 1 · KISS 1 · conventions 0.
